title: Varginha records strictly classified at the Ministry of Defense

tellings.quote: The information that's held by the Ministry of Defense is strictly classified.

plain: Brazil's Ministry of Defense keeps its files on the 1996 Varginha case secret. That case is the reported crash of a craft near the Brazilian town of Varginha and the capture of a creature there. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, says so himself: "The information that's held by the Ministry of Defense is strictly classified," which would mean the government holds records of the event that it has never released.
